reviewer.independence: Independent contract review only; no contract, source or acceptance-test authorship.

issues.criterion: interface.serialization: duplicate operation_id cannot overwrite prior operation/effect and returns conflict without executing.
issues.evidence: .agent/evidence/126/e126-08.stdout.txt records the promised duplicate-ID guard and all nine acceptance descriptions. No description requires resubmitting an existing operation_id. The duplicate control in AT3 concerns fixture claims. An implementation that reexecutes a completed ID and replaces its schema-valid record can satisfy the listed checks. This is a static coverage counterexample; no executable controller or mutant exists at this revision.
issues.required_fix: Within an existing command, require a fresh-ID positive control and repeated-ID submissions while outstanding and after completion. Assert explicit conflict, no second child receipt or effect, preservation of prior operation/result bytes, and continued legitimate fresh-ID operation. Include changed payload reuse so a duplicate cannot silently replace the prior outcome. Preserve the nine-command interface and independent test ownership.

missing_acceptance_coverage: Duplicate operation_id refusal before dispatch, including prevention of repeated effects and preservation of the original operation/result records, lacks an explicit acceptance obligation.
observations: The nine commands exactly match feature126's canonical list, and the proposed contract validates against the installed contract schema. No controller, stub or acceptance runner exists at the reviewed revision; missing-source execution is not used as a red result.

The six owned NIP-0003 stub cases map to AT4/5/6/7/8/9 (cases1/2/3/8-policy/9/13). AT1/2/3 add lifecycle, records and real fixture-registration obligations. Timeout, reattach, replay, SBCL and full seven-call conformance remain explicitly deferred.

Ownership, generation and lease refusals require child-receipt absence alongside memory/state checks, paired with legitimate operation success. This makes hidden dispatch and always-reject implementations falsifiable. Busy tests use a controlled gate and preserve the outstanding lane.

Upstream review_trial denial before endpoint contact is an error receipt rather than an admitted runtime operation, consistent with R10 endpoint denial. The separate trusted socket-injection path requires the supervisor-owned rejected/executed:false record demanded by R5 and case8; it does not confer endpoint authority on a trial.

Independent existing C12 controls actually returned0 for rejected trial and same-attempt replacement-generation fixtures, and1 with targeted C12 diagnostics for executed-trial and stale-generation execution negatives. These establish the record checks only, not controller behavior.

AT3's actual claim_map_check body can be isolated into a private Bash process for positive and scratch-mutant controls without sourcing the full fixture harness. Bundle review must reject duplicated checker logic, recursive harness execution, or a scheduling test that never exercises actual command dispatch/failure propagation.

The greenfield red plan is viable only after both gates and test seal: confirm transport/setup works, then capture the intended assertion/exit/output using an identified minimal scaffold or targeted semantic mutant plus positive control. Neither method proves pristine-base semantic red; provenance must state that limit.

Fresh QA can reconstruct committed controller/test/stub bytes in fresh subprocesses and private scratch state without SBCL or user namespaces. It must rerun all nine commands, required repository checks, and exactly one additional evaluator-originated spot-check, with real CI command evidence before live-case claims.

The550 independent-test estimate is feasible with shared subprocess, request, cleanup and schema helpers, but tight for malformed-child and harness controls. Product1100 plus tests550 plus process1250 equals2900; phase5650/7345 includes307 preparation lines once. Estimates are not actual measurement or permission to omit acceptance; Root must measure whole work and preserve phase limits.

final_verdict.summary: Reject narrowly: add explicit repeated-operation-ID admission/effect/record-preservation coverage within the existing nine commands, then obtain renewed independent pre-code reviews. No implementation or tests are authorized by this verdict.
